reasoning: The README's curl|bash command is documentation only and never executed during makepkg. PKGBUILD safely handles verified binary distribution with checksums.
disagreement_analysis: qwen incorrectly flagged README content as executable risk while deepseek correctly recognized it as non-executable documentation.
coverage_issues: qwen failed to review .nvchecker.toml and LICENSE files (though low-risk)
false_positives: qwen: README-0.9.4.md 'Unsafe install command' - Documentation isn't executed during packaging
learnings: Improve file prioritization: Focus exclusively on build/install hooks (PKGBUILD, .install) and referenced scripts
Clarify prompt: Explicitly state documentation files (READMEs, licenses) aren't security risks unless executed
Reduce false positives: Train models to distinguish between documented commands vs. actually executed code
